facts.fact: Banco de Moçambique announces that Law No. 15/2026 of 2 July approves the National Payment System Law and repeals Law No. 2/2008 of 27 February; the notice gives no start date, so as_of is the law's date of 2 July 2026.
facts.system: Lei do Sistema Nacional de Pagamentos (Lei n.º 15/2026)
